dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/18] At the post-intervention assessment, none of the adolescents in IPT-AST met diagnostic criteria for a depression diagnosis at post-treatment compared to 3 adolescents in SC (1 for major depressive episode, 2 for DD NOS). At 3-month follow-up, 1 adolescent in IPT-AST had developed a major depressive episode. No adolescents in SC had developed a new episode but 2 of the adolescents continued to have a depressive episode (1 continued DD NOS, 1 DD NOS developed into a major depressive episode). At the 6-month assessment, no adolescents in IPT-AST had [/page/5/Text/5] a depression diagnosis. In SC, a new adolescent met criteria for DD NOS and the two adolescents with diagnoses at 3 months continued to meet criteria (1 now met criteria for dysthymia, 1 had a continuing major depressive episode). Looking at these data collectively, 1 of the 27 (3.7%) IPT-AST adolescents had a depression diagnosis at any time during the 6-month follow-up period compared to 4 of the 14 (28.6%) SC adolescents
